brainstrike_askUser.description: Ask the user a clarifying question and WAIT for their answer (the run pauses). Provide options for a structured choice (selectionMode multi_select allows several), or omit options for a free-text question

options.description: Optional choices. Omit for a free-text question.

description.description: Optional context for the option (does not change the answer value).

label.description: Option label; the value returned when chosen.

question.description: The clear, specific question to ask the user.

selectionMode.description: How many options the user may pick. Requires options; defaults to single_select.

brainstrike_browserGetPageText.description: Read the visible text of the browser pane's current page (active tab), truncated to maxChars

brainstrike_browserNavigate.description: Open a URL in the app's embedded browser pane (creates a tab when none is open) and wait for the load. Bare hosts get https://; non-URL text becomes a web search. Returns the final url and title

brainstrike_browserReadPage.description: Read the browser pane's current page as a compact accessibility tree. Interactive elements carry [ref=eN] handles for later actions; filter 'interactive' returns only actionable elements

filter.description: 'interactive' returns only actionable elements; 'all' the full tree

maxChars.description: Maximum characters of tree text to return

brainstrike_deleteWorkspaceFile.description: Permanently delete a single file in a chosen open workspace root and invalidate its index rows. DESTRUCTIVE and NOT recoverable through the tool; refuses directories (use executeCommand) and acts on a symlink itself (removes the link, never its target). Workspace-scoped; requires approval

path.description: Workspace-relative file path; directories are refused

root.description: Open-folder name/id for this path. Required only when multiple folders are open.

brainstrike_executeCommand.description: Run a shell command for tests, builds, git, and other tools. NO sandbox: it can read or change anything the user can. Never run destructive commands unless explicitly requested. Requires per-call approval by default. Starts in a chosen open root; kills the process tree on timeout. Returns exitCode, bounded stdout/stderr tail, and durationMs

command.description: Shell command passed verbatim to `-c`; NO sandbox

cwd.description: Start directory, absolute or root-relative; must resolve inside an open folder

root.description: Open-folder name/id; required only with multiple folders

brainstrike_findWorkspaceSymbol.description: Locate a symbol's best-effort enclosing line range in a workspace file without returning whole-file content

query.description: Symbol name or substring to find

root.description: Open-folder name/id for this path. Required only when multiple folders are open.

brainstrike_globWorkspace.description: Enumerate workspace files whose path matches a glob (e.g. **/*.test.ts, src/**/*.tsx). One path per result line, prefixed with its root name when several folders are open. Excludes .git, build output, and gitignored paths by default; pass includeIgnored to see them; read-only

includeIgnored.description: Include excluded paths: build output, generated artifacts, and gitignored files such as coverage/ or .env* (default false)

pattern.description: Workspace-relative glob; bare patterns match at any depth

root.description: Open-folder name/id. Omit for the thread-bound folder; an unbound request searches all open folders. To cover every folder in a bound thread, call once per root id. Results include their root.

brainstrike_grepSearch.description: Grep indexed and live on-disk file content for an exact string or regex. Default 'files' mode surveys matching paths cheaply; 'content' mode (scoped with filePaths) returns matches grouped under one file header per file — 'root:path' when several folders are open — with 'line: text' rows ('-' marks opt-in context rows). Reuse that root and path (and the row's line number as startLine) in readWorkspaceFile calls

contextLines.description: Context lines around each 'content' match (default 0; opt in when needed)

filePaths.description: Restrict to these files: workspace-relative, or absolute inside an open folder

outputMode.description: 'files' (default): paths + match counts. 'content': matching lines; narrow with filePaths.

root.description: Open-folder name/id. Omit for the thread-bound folder; an unbound request searches all open folders. To cover every folder in a bound thread, call once per root id. Results include their root.

brainstrike_hybridSearch.description: Hybrid workspace search fusing semantic (vector) and exact-term (BM25 keyword) rankings with reciprocal rank fusion; best default for code/doc retrieval mixing concepts with distinctive terms. Omit embeddingSetId to use the Workspace Index; fails visibly (never degrades) if the keyword index is unavailable

embeddingSetId.description: Embedding set ID for vector search; omit to use the Workspace Index

root.description: Open-folder name/id. Omit for the thread-bound folder; an unbound request searches all open folders. To cover every folder in a bound thread, call once per root id. Results include their root.

brainstrike_inspectCommandSessions.description: List persistent command sessions in one open workspace root, or read bounded incremental PTY output. Continue a truncated list with offset and output with nextCursor; use read cursor -1 to attach at the live tail without replay. Read-only and workspace-scoped; command text, stdin, cwd, and PTY output are redacted from durable history

offset.description: Session offset from a previous truncated list page

cursor.description: Absolute read cursor; omit for retained output or use -1 for the live tail

sessionId.description: Opaque session id returned by start or list

operation.description: Exactly one inspection operation and only its valid fields

root.description: Open folder name or durable id; omit when only one folder is open

brainstrike_listEmbeddingSpaces.description: List available embedding spaces, workspace-index status, and optional coverage statistics

workspaceIndexOnly.description: Only return the embedding space configured as the current workspace index

brainstrike_listWorkspaceContext.description: Inspect open workspace roots, the Main operating-root path, Focused-root selected context, and workspace index hint without reading file contents; compact summary by default, detail: true for per-file Tapestry ranges

detail.description: Include full curated-context metadata with per-file Tapestry ranges (default: compact summary with counts and token budgets)

includeTokenEstimates.description: Include token estimates for selected files when available

offset.description: Skip this many selected file paths to continue a truncated listing

brainstrike_listWorktrees.description: List every git worktree the workspace knows about: path, branch, whether BrainStrike manages it, whether it is usable, and if not, why. Read-only.

root.description: Workspace root id or display name; omit to list every open root

brainstrike_lspInspect.description: LSP (Language Server Protocol) semantic code inspection for TypeScript/JavaScript: the inferred TYPE (hover), line diagnostics, the symbol's DEFINITION location, and its IMPLEMENTATIONS. Give the file path, 1-based line, and `match`: prefer the unique identifier itself (for example `computeTotal`); when it repeats on that line, pass a unique line fragment with exactly one `<<<` immediately before the intended occurrence. Wrong-line identifiers return bounded candidate lines for an explicit retry; ambiguous targets never guess. Read-only; returns a clear 'unavailable' note (not an error) for unsupported file types or when no server is available

line.description: 1-based line number of the symbol to inspect

match.description: Prefer one unique JS/TS identifier (cursor is its first character). If it repeats on the line, pass a unique fragment with exactly one `<<<` before the intended occurrence

root.description: Which open folder the path is in (required only when multiple are open)

brainstrike_manageCanvas.description: Create, list, or version-update a persisted HTML Canvas document for the current thread. create needs a title and a document with content: the write IS the deliverable, so never create an empty or placeholder canvas — call create once, when the content is ready. update replaces oldString only when it occurs exactly once; rewrite replaces the whole HTML. Every change creates a new reversible version

html.description: Complete HTML; required for create and rewrite (max 8 MB of UTF-8)

newString.description: Update replacement; may be empty (max 8 MB of UTF-8)

oldString.description: Update target; must occur exactly once

brainstrike_manageCommandSession.description: Start, write to, stop, or remove a persistent PTY command session in one open workspace root. Pass exactly one typed operation. Use this for servers and interactive commands that must outlive one tool call; use executeCommand for normal bounded commands. Arbitrary execution with no sandbox; requires approval by default

cwd.description: Absolute or workspace-relative directory inside the selected root

sessionId.description: Opaque session id returned by start or list
Opaque session id returned by start or list
Opaque session id returned by start or list

operation.description: Exactly one process-control operation and only its valid fields

root.description: Open folder name or durable id; omit when only one folder is open

brainstrike_manageTaskList.description: Record and update a structured plan for the current thread as a task list (whole-list replace). Each task has content (imperative label), activeForm (present-tense in-progress label), and status pending/in_progress/completed. Keep exactly one task in_progress; mark tasks completed as you finish them. The list is re-shown to you every turn and rendered to the user as a progress checklist

activeForm.description: Present-tense in-progress label, e.g. "Implementing the parser"

content.description: Imperative task label, e.g. "Implement the parser"

status.description: Task status; keep exactly one task in_progress

tasks.description: The full task list to store (whole-list replace — pass the entire desired list every call). Maximum 50 tasks.

brainstrike_manageWorktree.description: Create an isolated git worktree for the current repository, or archive one. create takes a branch name and a base ref; archive takes the worktree id from listWorktrees and refuses a dirty or in-use worktree unless force is set. Archiving always captures a restorable snapshot first.

baseRef.description: Base ref for create; defaults to HEAD

force.description: Archive a dirty or unpushed worktree anyway; never overrides an active run

name.description: Directory name; defaults to the branch name

root.description: Workspace root id or display name

brainstrike_queryDiagnostics.description: Query Brainstrike durable diagnostic events without re-running the app. Use mode=events for newest matching rows or mode=fingerprints to group recurring failures. Filters are exact severity/fingerprint/run/thread plus an inclusive ISO time window; results are hard-capped and output-budget truncation is explicit. Read-only

limit.description: Maximum events or groups to inspect (default 50, hard max 200)

mode.description: events returns newest rows; fingerprints groups recurring failures

brainstrike_queryEmbeddingSpace.description: Query semantic workspace context; omit embeddingSetId to use the Workspace Index by default

root.description: Open-folder name/id. Omit for the thread-bound folder; an unbound request searches all open folders. To cover every folder in a bound thread, call once per root id. Results include their root.

brainstrike_readToolOutputArtifact.description: Page/grep; never alter or recreate the cursor.

cursor.description: Prior cursor; copy byte-for-byte, never edit or recreate it.

brainstrike_readWorkspaceContext.description: Read selected or explicit workspace files under strict file and token budgets after semantic search needs exact source

filePaths.description: Workspace-relative file paths to read. Defaults to selected workspace context.

root.description: Open-folder name/id for this path. Required only when multiple folders are open.

useTapestrySelections.description: Apply selected Tapestry line ranges when reading curated workspace context

brainstrike_readWorkspaceDirectory.description: List a workspace directory in a compact, token-efficient format

root.description: Open-folder name/id for this path. Required only when multiple folders are open.

brainstrike_readWorkspaceFile.description: Read a file from a chosen open workspace root as bounded, line-numbered pages with a short thread-scoped continuation handle. For later pages pass only cursor (and optional maxChars); omit path/root/startLine/endLine

cursor.description: Short nextCursor handle from the previous page. Pass it unchanged with optional maxChars and omit every other field

endLine.description: Last 1-based line; omit with cursor unless replaying the original value unchanged

path.description: Workspace-relative file path; required only when starting a new read

root.description: Open-folder name/id for this path. Required only when multiple folders are open.

startLine.description: First 1-based line; omit with cursor unless replaying the original value unchanged

brainstrike_renameWorkspaceFile.description: Rename or move a single file within a chosen open workspace root, creating missing destination parents and invalidating the source index rows. Refuses overwriting an existing destination and refuses directories; refuses if the source changed on disk since you last read it — re-read and retry; acts on a symlink itself (moves the link, never its target). Workspace-scoped; requires approval

root.description: Open-folder name/id for this path. Required only when multiple folders are open.

toPath.description: Destination path in the same root; no overwrite; creates missing parents

brainstrike_runPython.description: Run Python in an OS sandbox for computation, parsing, and data wrangling. Network only to allowedDomains you name, each run needing explicit per-call user approval (omit for none); writes only to a scratch dir deleted afterwards; reads unrestricted. print() to return values. Requires approval

allowedDomains.description: Public domains the script may reach, by name (e.g. "pypi.org", "*.example.com"); [] or omitted for no network. IP literals, localhost, and .local are not allowed. Each domain requires explicit user approval per call.

code.description: Python source to run as a script; print() to return values

brainstrike_runSkillScript.description: Run an enabled Agent Skill's listed script with literal argv in a mounted root/cwd. Resolution and approval required

root.description: Mounted root name or id

brainstrike_stringReplaceWorkspaceFile.description: Surgically edit a file in a chosen open workspace root by replacing one oldStr block with newStr (fuzzy-matched; refuses ambiguous matches; refuses if the file changed on disk since you last read it — re-read and retry; workspace-scoped, requires approval). matchType "exact" confirms verbatim placement; other matchTypes are fuzzy — re-read for precision

newStr.description: Replacement text; empty deletes the matched block

oldStr.description: Existing text block. Use whole lines and enough context to identify one location; ambiguous matches are refused.

root.description: Open-folder name/id for this path. Required only when multiple folders are open.

brainstrike_submitPlan.description: Submit a structured implementation plan (title, overview, ordered steps, optional risks/verification) for the user to Approve or Reject. The run PAUSES until they respond; rejection feedback is returned so you can revise and resubmit

overview.description: One or two paragraphs summarizing the plan and its goal.

risks.description: Optional risks, tradeoffs, or things that could go wrong.

verification.description: Optional how-to-verify: tests, checks, or acceptance criteria.

brainstrike_updateWorkspaceContextSelect.description: Bulk add, remove, or replace files selected in the workspace context explorer for reusable curated context

filePaths.description: Workspace-relative file paths to select in the workspace context explorer

folderId.description: Optional folder id for multi-root workspaces

root.description: Open-folder name/id. Omit for the Focused folder; an explicit root always wins.

brainstrike_updateWorkspaceTapestrySelec.description: Create, update, or clear token-aware Tapestry line ranges for selected workspace context files

folderId.description: Optional folder id for multi-root workspaces

mode.description: Range update strategy for each file (default: replace)

root.description: Open-folder name/id. Omit for the Focused folder; an explicit root always wins.

selectFiles.description: Also add affected files to the workspace context selection (default: true)

color.description: Group color; reuse per concept; omit to auto-assign

isActive.description: Whether this range contributes to context output

ranges.description: 1-based inclusive line ranges for this file

updates.description: Tapestry selection updates grouped by file

brainstrike_webExtract.description: Fetch the readable content of up to 5 public web pages as markdown (the natural follow-up to webSearch results, or for a user-pasted URL). SENDS THE URLS TO AN EXTERNAL EXTRACTION SERVICE (Tavily); refuses non-http(s), credentialed, and private/internal URLs before anything is sent. Preserves complete source content; larger results provide an exact brainstrike.readToolOutputArtifact continuation cursor. Returns a clear "unavailable" message (not an error) when no Tavily key is configured

items.description: Absolute http(s) URL of a PUBLIC page — never internal/private hosts

urls.description: Public web pages to extract as markdown (1-5). Sent to an external extraction service (Tavily) — never include URLs carrying secrets or pointing at private/internal hosts.

brainstrike_webSearch.description: Search the web for current docs, APIs, error messages, and library usage. SENDS YOUR QUERY TO AN EXTERNAL WEB-SEARCH SERVICE (the model provider's built-in search when available, otherwise Tavily). Returns a clear "unavailable" message (not an error) when no provider-native search and no Tavily key are configured

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 5, max 10)

query.description: The web search query. Sent to an external search service (Tavily) — never include secrets or private workspace contents.

brainstrike_writeWorkspaceFile.description: Write or create a UTF-8 file in a chosen open workspace root (overwrites existing content; refuses if the file changed on disk since you last read it — re-read and retry; workspace-scoped, requires approval). bytesWritten confirms it landed; skip re-reading

content.description: Full UTF-8 content (up to ~2 MB); overwrites an existing file

path.description: Workspace-relative path; creates missing parent directories

root.description: Open-folder name/id for this path. Required only when multiple folders are open.

skill.description: Activate a skill by name or path.

skill_read.description: Read a skill reference, script, or asset by relative path.

root.description: Open-folder name/id for this path. Required only when multiple folders are open.

brainstrike_globWorkspace.description: Enumerate workspace files whose path matches a glob (e.g. **/*.test.ts, src/**/*.tsx). One path per result line, prefixed with its root name when several folders are open. Excludes .git, build output, and gitignored paths by default; pass includeIgnored to see them; read-only

includeIgnored.description: Include excluded paths: build output, generated artifacts, and gitignored files such as coverage/ or .env* (default false)

pattern.description: Workspace-relative glob; bare patterns match at any depth

root.description: Open-folder name/id. Omit for the thread-bound folder; an unbound request searches all open folders. To cover every folder in a bound thread, call once per root id. Results include their root.

brainstrike_grepSearch.description: Grep indexed and live on-disk file content for an exact string or regex. Default 'files' mode surveys matching paths cheaply; 'content' mode (scoped with filePaths) returns matches grouped under one file header per file — 'root:path' when several folders are open — with 'line: text' rows ('-' marks opt-in context rows). Reuse that root and path (and the row's line number as startLine) in readWorkspaceFile calls

contextLines.description: Context lines around each 'content' match (default 0; opt in when needed)

filePaths.description: Restrict to these files: workspace-relative, or absolute inside an open folder

outputMode.description: 'files' (default): paths + match counts. 'content': matching lines; narrow with filePaths.

root.description: Open-folder name/id. Omit for the thread-bound folder; an unbound request searches all open folders. To cover every folder in a bound thread, call once per root id. Results include their root.

brainstrike_hybridSearch.description: Hybrid workspace search fusing semantic (vector) and exact-term (BM25 keyword) rankings with reciprocal rank fusion; best default for code/doc retrieval mixing concepts with distinctive terms. Omit embeddingSetId to use the Workspace Index; fails visibly (never degrades) if the keyword index is unavailable

embeddingSetId.description: Embedding set ID for vector search; omit to use the Workspace Index

root.description: Open-folder name/id. Omit for the thread-bound folder; an unbound request searches all open folders. To cover every folder in a bound thread, call once per root id. Results include their root.

brainstrike_inspectCommandSessions.description: List persistent command sessions in one open workspace root, or read bounded incremental PTY output. Continue a truncated list with offset and output with nextCursor; use read cursor -1 to attach at the live tail without replay. Read-only and workspace-scoped; command text, stdin, cwd, and PTY output are redacted from durable history

offset.description: Session offset from a previous truncated list page

cursor.description: Absolute read cursor; omit for retained output or use -1 for the live tail

sessionId.description: Opaque session id returned by start or list

operation.description: Exactly one inspection operation and only its valid fields

root.description: Open folder name or durable id; omit when only one folder is open

brainstrike_listEmbeddingSpaces.description: List available embedding spaces, workspace-index status, and optional coverage statistics

workspaceIndexOnly.description: Only return the embedding space configured as the current workspace index

brainstrike_listWorkspaceContext.description: Inspect open workspace roots, the Main operating-root path, Focused-root selected context, and workspace index hint without reading file contents; compact summary by default, detail: true for per-file Tapestry ranges

detail.description: Include full curated-context metadata with per-file Tapestry ranges (default: compact summary with counts and token budgets)

includeTokenEstimates.description: Include token estimates for selected files when available

offset.description: Skip this many selected file paths to continue a truncated listing

brainstrike_lspInspect.description: LSP (Language Server Protocol) semantic code inspection for TypeScript/JavaScript: the inferred TYPE (hover), line diagnostics, the symbol's DEFINITION location, and its IMPLEMENTATIONS. Give the file path, 1-based line, and `match`: prefer the unique identifier itself (for example `computeTotal`); when it repeats on that line, pass a unique line fragment with exactly one `<<<` immediately before the intended occurrence. Wrong-line identifiers return bounded candidate lines for an explicit retry; ambiguous targets never guess. Read-only; returns a clear 'unavailable' note (not an error) for unsupported file types or when no server is available

line.description: 1-based line number of the symbol to inspect

match.description: Prefer one unique JS/TS identifier (cursor is its first character). If it repeats on the line, pass a unique fragment with exactly one `<<<` before the intended occurrence

root.description: Which open folder the path is in (required only when multiple are open)

brainstrike_manageCanvas.description: Create, list, or version-update a persisted HTML Canvas document for the current thread. create needs a title and a document with content: the write IS the deliverable, so never create an empty or placeholder canvas — call create once, when the content is ready. update replaces oldString only when it occurs exactly once; rewrite replaces the whole HTML. Every change creates a new reversible version

html.description: Complete HTML; required for create and rewrite (max 8 MB of UTF-8)

newString.description: Update replacement; may be empty (max 8 MB of UTF-8)

oldString.description: Update target; must occur exactly once

brainstrike_manageCommandSession.description: Start, write to, stop, or remove a persistent PTY command session in one open workspace root. Pass exactly one typed operation. Use this for servers and interactive commands that must outlive one tool call; use executeCommand for normal bounded commands. Arbitrary execution with no sandbox; requires approval by default

cwd.description: Absolute or workspace-relative directory inside the selected root

sessionId.description: Opaque session id returned by start or list
Opaque session id returned by start or list
Opaque session id returned by start or list

operation.description: Exactly one process-control operation and only its valid fields

root.description: Open folder name or durable id; omit when only one folder is open

brainstrike_manageTaskList.description: Record and update a structured plan for the current thread as a task list (whole-list replace). Each task has content (imperative label), activeForm (present-tense in-progress label), and status pending/in_progress/completed. Keep exactly one task in_progress; mark tasks completed as you finish them. The list is re-shown to you every turn and rendered to the user as a progress checklist

activeForm.description: Present-tense in-progress label, e.g. "Implementing the parser"

content.description: Imperative task label, e.g. "Implement the parser"

status.description: Task status; keep exactly one task in_progress

tasks.description: The full task list to store (whole-list replace — pass the entire desired list every call). Maximum 50 tasks.

brainstrike_queryDiagnostics.description: Query Brainstrike durable diagnostic events without re-running the app. Use mode=events for newest matching rows or mode=fingerprints to group recurring failures. Filters are exact severity/fingerprint/run/thread plus an inclusive ISO time window; results are hard-capped and output-budget truncation is explicit. Read-only

limit.description: Maximum events or groups to inspect (default 50, hard max 200)

mode.description: events returns newest rows; fingerprints groups recurring failures

brainstrike_queryEmbeddingSpace.description: Query semantic workspace context; omit embeddingSetId to use the Workspace Index by default

root.description: Open-folder name/id. Omit for the thread-bound folder; an unbound request searches all open folders. To cover every folder in a bound thread, call once per root id. Results include their root.

brainstrike_readToolOutputArtifact.description: Page/grep; never alter or recreate the cursor.

cursor.description: Prior cursor; copy byte-for-byte, never edit or recreate it.

filePaths.description: Workspace-relative file paths to read. Defaults to selected workspace context.

root.description: Open-folder name/id for this path. Required only when multiple folders are open.

useTapestrySelections.description: Apply selected Tapestry line ranges when reading curated workspace context

brainstrike_readWorkspaceDirectory.description: List a workspace directory in a compact, token-efficient format

root.description: Open-folder name/id for this path. Required only when multiple folders are open.

brainstrike_readWorkspaceFile.description: Read a file from a chosen open workspace root as bounded, line-numbered pages with a short thread-scoped continuation handle. For later pages pass only cursor (and optional maxChars); omit path/root/startLine/endLine

cursor.description: Short nextCursor handle from the previous page. Pass it unchanged with optional maxChars and omit every other field

endLine.description: Last 1-based line; omit with cursor unless replaying the original value unchanged

path.description: Workspace-relative file path; required only when starting a new read

root.description: Open-folder name/id for this path. Required only when multiple folders are open.

startLine.description: First 1-based line; omit with cursor unless replaying the original value unchanged

brainstrike_renameWorkspaceFile.description: Rename or move a single file within a chosen open workspace root, creating missing destination parents and invalidating the source index rows. Refuses overwriting an existing destination and refuses directories; refuses if the source changed on disk since you last read it — re-read and retry; acts on a symlink itself (moves the link, never its target). Workspace-scoped; requires approval

root.description: Open-folder name/id for this path. Required only when multiple folders are open.

toPath.description: Destination path in the same root; no overwrite; creates missing parents

brainstrike_runPython.description: Run Python in an OS sandbox for computation, parsing, and data wrangling. Network only to allowedDomains you name, each run needing explicit per-call user approval (omit for none); writes only to a scratch dir deleted afterwards; reads unrestricted. print() to return values. Requires approval

allowedDomains.description: Public domains the script may reach, by name (e.g. "pypi.org", "*.example.com"); [] or omitted for no network. IP literals, localhost, and .local are not allowed. Each domain requires explicit user approval per call.

code.description: Python source to run as a script; print() to return values

brainstrike_stringReplaceWorkspaceFile.description: Surgically edit a file in a chosen open workspace root by replacing one oldStr block with newStr (fuzzy-matched; refuses ambiguous matches; refuses if the file changed on disk since you last read it — re-read and retry; workspace-scoped, requires approval). matchType "exact" confirms verbatim placement; other matchTypes are fuzzy — re-read for precision

newStr.description: Replacement text; empty deletes the matched block

oldStr.description: Existing text block. Use whole lines and enough context to identify one location; ambiguous matches are refused.

root.description: Open-folder name/id for this path. Required only when multiple folders are open.

brainstrike_submitPlan.description: Submit a structured implementation plan (title, overview, ordered steps, optional risks/verification) for the user to Approve or Reject. The run PAUSES until they respond; rejection feedback is returned so you can revise and resubmit

overview.description: One or two paragraphs summarizing the plan and its goal.

risks.description: Optional risks, tradeoffs, or things that could go wrong.

verification.description: Optional how-to-verify: tests, checks, or acceptance criteria.

brainstrike_updateWorkspaceContextSelect.description: Bulk add, remove, or replace files selected in the workspace context explorer for reusable curated context

filePaths.description: Workspace-relative file paths to select in the workspace context explorer

folderId.description: Optional folder id for multi-root workspaces

root.description: Open-folder name/id. Omit for the Focused folder; an explicit root always wins.

brainstrike_updateWorkspaceTapestrySelec.description: Create, update, or clear token-aware Tapestry line ranges for selected workspace context files

folderId.description: Optional folder id for multi-root workspaces

mode.description: Range update strategy for each file (default: replace)

root.description: Open-folder name/id. Omit for the Focused folder; an explicit root always wins.

selectFiles.description: Also add affected files to the workspace context selection (default: true)

color.description: Group color; reuse per concept; omit to auto-assign

isActive.description: Whether this range contributes to context output

ranges.description: 1-based inclusive line ranges for this file

updates.description: Tapestry selection updates grouped by file

brainstrike_webExtract.description: Fetch the readable content of up to 5 public web pages as markdown (the natural follow-up to webSearch results, or for a user-pasted URL). SENDS THE URLS TO AN EXTERNAL EXTRACTION SERVICE (Tavily); refuses non-http(s), credentialed, and private/internal URLs before anything is sent. Preserves complete source content; larger results provide an exact brainstrike.readToolOutputArtifact continuation cursor. Returns a clear "unavailable" message (not an error) when no Tavily key is configured

items.description: Absolute http(s) URL of a PUBLIC page — never internal/private hosts

urls.description: Public web pages to extract as markdown (1-5). Sent to an external extraction service (Tavily) — never include URLs carrying secrets or pointing at private/internal hosts.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 5, max 10)

query.description: The web search query. Sent to an external search service (Tavily) — never include secrets or private workspace contents.
